items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I was quite a minstrel man back in the old days with Bonnie Casey and Dennis Casey and Warren Spawn.

ctx.x: You're going to get that they have good articles.

Well, he asked me about it. And I won't do it. But it's just procrastination. That's the thief of time. And believe me, I am the world's worst on letter writing. But one of these days, I'll send him an epistle. It'll be a little lengthier than a letter. But I fully intend to do so. And I hope it won't. It'll be forthcoming right soon. You might tell him if you will be kind enough, you said you'd call him and let him know about that or let Mr. Harry know about it, about the bass. I caught his show, This Is Your…
5120 St. Charles. I worked in that building. Is that right? I catalogued the collection that Doc gave to the library up there.
